stem: A grower wants to compare canopy PPFD maps before and after changing fixture height. Which measurement practice gives the strongest comparison?
choices: Use the same grid positions, canopy plane, meter orientation, and stabilized lighting conditions for both maps
Measure different random points each time
Use the brightest point before the change and the dimmest point after it
Change fixture power while collecting each map
rationale: Repeatable spatial sampling controls measurement context so differences are more likely to reflect the fixture-height change rather than a changed measurement method.
